CarPlayRecordingService.swift:1820 installs cleanup for unsuccessful secureWorkNote exits; :1435 covers caller exits before ownership transfers to STT at :1575. The no-gateway renderer now includes the hint, but an initial startup failure never triggers that renderer. beginWorkNote leaves state at .idle; startup failures call endSession(speak: nil), which assigns .idle again. The scene observes only state, and Observation suppresses equal-value assignments. The new renderer test detects the old missing branch but does not cover this lifecycle failure; see R1.

findings.title: Initial microphone failures never trigger the new hint or modal dismissal
findings.claim: S3 remains reproducible because the added hint depends on a picker refresh that silent initial-start failures do not schedule.
findings.evidence: CarPlayRecordingService.State is Equatable (:142), initially .idle (:162). beginWorkNote (:603) changes sessionActive but leaves state unchanged; state becomes .recording only after successful startup (:894). Activation failure (:738) or exhausted engine retries (:833) sets the hint callback and calls endSession(speak: nil), whose final assignment is state = .idle (:2791). CarPlaySceneDelegate.swift:124 only sets the hint flag, while :1065 observes only service.state. Equal assignments bypass notification in the installed Observation macro, matching the [official Swift Observable macro](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/lib/Macros/Sources/ObservationMacros/ObservableMacro.swift#L342). Consequently applyState(.idle), dismissal and refreshPicker are not invoked.
findings.scenario: With microphone permission granted and no gateway configured, let the initial picker refresh finish. Tap Add to Work and encounter an activation failure or exhausted engine-start retries before recording begins. The session ends internally, but the Listening modal remains and the new microphone-failure hint is not shown. If activation succeeded before engine failure, dismissal-driven audio deactivation is also missed.
findings.fix: Explicitly notify the scene after silent startup teardown so it dismisses the modal and refreshes the picker without relying on an idle-to-idle assignment. Add a regression covering the startup-failure event path.
findings.refutationAttempt: Checked other observed properties, speech completion, conversation notifications and the End button. The observer tracks only state; an initial silent failure has no speech completion or conversation write. End subsequently reaches endSession's sessionActive guard and returns. An unrelated later scene activation can recover the UI, but does not close the reported scenario. CarPlayWorkNoteTests.swift:482 checks renderer text only and passes with this failure intact.
